description: Did something change sharply yesterday? (read-only) Compares the last full local day with the usual day (the average of the days before the last two): spend spike or drop, zero or falling purchases (possible broken pixel or store), ROAS drop, cost-per-purchase spike. Account level. Days follow SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET; today is left out.

baseline_days.description: How many earlier days to compare against.

min_daily_spend.description: Below this usual daily spend nothing is judged

name: snap_anomaly_check
